project_info.context: Mobile-first Nightlife & Events Social Platform Admin Dashboard
project_info.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Dark Nightlife Club Aesthetic)
principles: Keep 100% existing functionality — Reorganization and visual polish only
Declutter overloaded Scrapers tab into logical, collapsible, structured sub-sections
Enhance scannability and visual hierarchy with cohesive glassmorphism and clear sub-section headers
Ensure touch targets are mobile-first (≥40px) while scaling cleanly onto larger displays with max-width containers and responsive grid columns
Maintain existing dark neon identity (#FF0055 hot pink, #00F0FF cyan, Unbounded display font, Outfit body font)

accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 40px height for all tab buttons, row items, and interactive toggles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor AdminDashboard.js to introduce organized sub-groups in the Scrapers tab without modifying internal business logic or API calls of sub-components.

Ensure all existing sub-components (AdminCitiesPanel, AdminScrapeChangelog, AdminClubTicketsCoverage, AdminAffiliatePanel, AdminScrapersPanel, AdminVenuePriority, AdminVenuesPanel) are rendered inside their respective sub-section wrappers.
Add sub-navigation quick links/pills at the top of the Scrapers tab to allow instant expanding/collapsing or auto-scrolling to relevant sub-sections.
Apply responsive grid layouts for StatBoxes and summary cards so desktop displays utilize wide space cleanly without ballooning component widths.
Ensure Sonner toasts, Recharts, and testids are fully preserved.
